product.name: TerraSprout 4‑Tier Vertical Planter
product.description: The TerraSprout 4‑Tier Vertical Planter offers a space‑saving solution for growing herbs, succulents, or ornamental plants in apartments or small balconies. Constructed from lightweight PVC panels and a sturdy wooden frame, it stands 60 cm tall and 30 cm wide, providing four independent planting compartments. Each tier is lined with a breathable fabric mat that retains moisture while preventing root rot. The planter’s matte forest‑green finish blends seamlessly with indoor décor, and its modular design allows easy assembly and disassembly for cleaning or transport. Ideal for indoor or outdoor use, it supports a variety of plant types and adds a vertical green touch to any space.
